system.story: The crew simply fights better with you calling it - the warlord's core presence.

effect.after:
Maneuver, no Influence. Choose an ally who can see or hear you. They gain one of: an edge on their next roll, a short burst of free movement, or a minor damage/defense bump until the start of your next turn.

Enhance (spend 1 Influence): grant the benefit to two more allies, or upgrade it to a free action or free strike for the chosen ally.

Influence loop: when a directed ally lands a Tier-1 result on the action you granted, gain bonus Influence (successful direction).
